description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B: What Parameter names, types, directions and order does a temporary QueryDef expose for: declared pA Long and [p B] Text(255) plus an undeclared pC; a name declared twice with two types; two undeclared names differing only in case ([p], [P]); and a declared parameter the body does not use? The first is opened after setting pA = 1, [p B] = 'b', pC = 3; the others are opened without values. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
